months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달(옛 채집 기록)이며, 번식지에서는 4~5월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라에서는 몇 차례 채집된 기록만 있는 미조이다. 홀로 또는 암수가 함께 산지 숲에 살며, 쥐 같은 설치류와 꿩, 들꿩 같은 새를 잡아먹는다. 높은 나무의 가지 위에 나뭇가지로 접시 모양 둥지를 짓고 알을 2개쯤 낳아 28~30일 동안 품는다. 한국, 일본, 중국, 인도, 히말라야, 동남아시아 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Mountain Hawk-Eagle (Nisaetus nipalensis), adult in Korean mountain forest: crown, face and the short crest of a few feathers on the hindcrown dark blackish-brown, the hindneck and neck sides dark brown with fine buff streaks; chin and throat white with a black central throat stripe and dark moustachial stripes; upper breast white with bold dark brown streaks; lower breast, belly, flanks and feathered legs barred dark brown and white; upperparts dark brown, the wing coverts with pale greyish-buff feather fringes; tail grey-brown with several evenly spaced broad dark bands and a pale tip. Bill dark grey and deeply hooked, with a grey cere; iris bright yellow; toes yellow with black talons.
art.pose: perched on a high branch of a tall tree, side view

adult, head in side view: short dark crest on the hindcrown, blackish-brown crown and face, buff-streaked hindneck, dark moustachial stripe, white throat with black central stripe, bright yellow iris, strong dark hooked bill with a grey cere

adult, flight seen from below: broad rounded wings with bulging secondaries, pale underwing with dark barring across the flight feathers, barred belly, long tail with broad dark bands; head, body and tail in one line
art.build: A large, powerful forest eagle, males 72cm and females 80cm, clearly larger than an Eastern Buzzard; perches upright with a long tail and long, fully feathered legs. Head fairly large with a short crest on the hindcrown. Bill strong, deeply hooked, shorter than the head. Legs feathered down to the toes and barred; toes yellow with big black talons. At rest the wingtips fall well short of the tail tip. In flight: broad, rounded wings with bulging secondaries and pinched-in bases, barred flight feathers, long banded tail.
avoid: Do not paint a long, flowing crest; the northern birds that reach Korea have only a short crest of a few feathers.
Do not paint bare yellow lower legs like a buzzard or sea-eagle; the legs are feathered to the toes and barred.
Do not paint a plain unmarked white breast; there is a black central throat stripe and dark breast streaks above the barred belly.
Do not paint a short tail or long wings reaching the tail tip; the tail is long and the wings are broad and rounded.
Do not give the adult a pale buff or tawny head and plain buff underparts; that is the juvenile. The adult head is dark brown.
